purpose: Define the review checks required before a parameter_set_candidate may be promoted into parameter_sets for operator acceptance review.

promotion_requirements.requirement: Candidate must select exactly one allowed operator class before promotion review.
Candidate parameter rows must replace placeholder value/unit states with sourced values or explicit noncomputable placeholders allowed by the selected operator class.
Candidate must record lock_timestamp_utc and set locked_before_holdout_evaluation=true before promotion.
Candidate must preserve calibration_source_rows, forbidden_source_rows, and source_hashes consistent with the frozen split manifest.
Candidate claim_use must remain non-validation language until accepted operator, residual emitter, and uncertainty provenance exist.

blocked_claims: a candidate parameter set is already an accepted parameter set
placeholder parameter rows can be treated as locked accepted values
claim_boundary: This manifest defines promotion review for parameter candidates only. It does not accept parameters or validate an operator.
